# NightZeros

> Independent studio building open-source AI and developer tools.
> Brand statement: Build beyond the obvious.

NightZeros ships practical developer products in the open. The current flagship project is ChatAI (NZ/001).

## Site

- [Home](https://nightszeros.com/): Studio overview
- [Projects](https://nightszeros.com/projects): What NightZeros is building
- [ChatAI](https://nightszeros.com/chatai): Product page for NZ/001
- [Open Source](https://nightszeros.com/open-source): Source, packages, contributing posture
- [About](https://nightszeros.com/about): Studio mission and principles
- [Security](https://nightszeros.com/security): Responsible disclosure and product security posture

## Product

- [ChatAI app](https://app.nightzeros.com/): Hosted ChatAI application
- [ChatAI docs](https://docs.nightzeros.com/): Installation, configuration, privacy, self-hosting
- [Security policy](https://docs.nightzeros.com/security): Vulnerability reporting guidance
- [Privacy](https://docs.nightzeros.com/privacy): Privacy documentation
- [Self-hosting](https://docs.nightzeros.com/self-hosting): Run ChatAI yourself
